concept: Aura Sentinel V50 — continuous shoulder-torso shell, displaced crescent and asymmetric hip mantle
authoringIntent: Replace V49's small plate/tab read with three large connected systems. The first system must sweep from the left shoulder across the upper torso and around the right flank with changing depth, taper and overlap. The second system is a deliberately displaced open dorsal crescent whose center remains empty in rear and three-quarter views. The third system continues the diagonal material language through hip and upper legs with one asymmetric mantle mass instead of detached tabs. The exact official Lucario body remains unchanged underneath. This file is pre-production source only; the current registry remains REFERENCE_READY until a deterministic builder and professional manifest are authored and validated.
referenceCarryForward: Ruins Style: use progressive rotation and parent-safe segmentation to make several thin elements read as one flexible contour. Do not copy the costume silhouette, segmented head cloth, ring motif, palette or markings.

Space Style: continue one material envelope across torso and lower body while preserving biological landmarks and animation hierarchy. Do not copy the suit, helmet, visor, panel layout, palette or markings.

Covert Style: connect head/shoulder/torso masses with deliberate openings around anatomy and preserve motion-safe parent chains. Do not copy the hood/cloak profile, garment layout, palette, markings or UV design.
